fact: Orange Digital Center Guinea-Bissau, with WARDIP, announced the official launch of its startup incubation and acceleration programme, with applications open 1-20 May 2026 and no cohort yet named.
The InoDevGB incubator in Bissau was inaugurated by the minister and began activities on 25 September 2025 training 15 young people selected from 52 proposals.
InnovaLab in Bissau says it assists startups at every stage with funding, incubation and accelerator programs, and has trained over 10,000 individuals.

UNDP says Kau Criar, an innovation hub under Impact Hub Bissau's temporary management, is open to entrepreneurs with hot desks, meeting rooms, ecosystem gatherings and capacity building, its legal structure still to be concluded.
